index.title: Documentation
index.description: All of Meeko's documentation: the framework guide, the component API, editors, DevTools, stability, architecture, migration and changes.
index.lead: Everything you need to write .meeko components and full-stack applications with Meeko.

reference.title: API reference
reference.lead: {total} Meeko symbols grouped by what they are. Each page explains one with its exact type, generated from the source code, its parameters, real examples and the errors you get from misusing it.
